review_note: Statewide state of emergency for the winter storm of January 28, 2014 (Governor's press release, January 28, 2014).
State of emergency for 14 North Georgia counties under a winter storm warning (Governor's press release, February 10, 2014).
State of emergency for 15 North Georgia counties under a winter storm warning, with icing and gusty winds forecast (Governor's press release, February 15, 2015).
State of emergency for 50 North Georgia counties under a winter storm warning, from 2 p.m. on February 25, 2015 (Governor's press release, February 24, 2015).
Fannin, Gilmer and Pickens counties: severe weather that caused flooding, road and property damage and downed trees; signed December 24, 2015 (Governor's press release).
State of emergency for 15 counties under a winter storm warning (Governor's press release, January 19, 2016).
New state of emergency for 21 counties ahead of a second winter storm that week, with freezing rain and snow possible (Governor's press release, January 21, 2016).
Atkinson, Berrien, Brooks, Colquitt, Cook, Lowndes and Thomas counties: severe storms that produced tornadoes on January 21 and 22, 2017 (Governor's press release, January 22, 2017).
State of emergency for 28 counties under a winter storm warning, through January 5, 2018 (Governor's press release, January 2, 2018).
FEMA release of January 24, 2000 (archived): The Governor of Georgia has declared a local state of emergency for 20 hard-hit counties. No signing day is given, so the release date is used.
CNN, February 15, 2000: Governor Roy Barnes has declared a state of emergency. No signing day is given, so the report date is used.
Perdue executive order list, 2004: 'Declaring a State of Emergency', September 1, 2004; EO 09.15.04.01 recites the state of emergency previously declared on September 1, 2004.
Order text: the presence of Hurricane Ivan continues to pose a threat of significant wind and flood damage; extends the state of emergency to September 20, 2004.
Perdue executive order list, 2007: 'Issuing a State of Emergency in Baker, Clay, McDuffie, Stewart, Sumter, and Taylor Counties', March 2, 2007 (expanded the same day by 03.02.07.02).
Perdue executive order list, 2008: 'Issuing a State of Emergency in the City of Atlanta due to severe weather and tornadoes', March 15, 2008.
Perdue executive order list, 2008: 'Declaring a State of Emergency in Bibb, Carroll, Douglas, Jefferson, Johnson, and Laurens Counties due to severe weather', May 11, 2008.
Perdue executive order list, 2009: 'Declaring a State of Emergency in Baker, Colquitt, Miller, Tift, Turner, and Worth Counties', March 30, 2009, amended April 3 and April 10 to add counties.
Perdue executive order list, 2009: 'Declaring a State of Emergency for 17 Georgia counties affected by heavy rain and severe weather', September 21, 2009.
